The Graves of Heroes

Here lie the simple tombstones of Sir Waine and his squire Tycel, two of the bravest paladins ever to raise sword in the service of Duke and Lady. The graves are heavily marked by hammer and chisel for the knights of Thring hold it to be lucky to place a fragment of the two stones on either side of their sword pommels, but they still stand together as the two did in life.

Hooks

  • What has kept the enemies of Thring from desecrating these graves?
